messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sertraline carries a boxed warning, the FDA's most serious type of warning.
Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in children, teenagers, and young adults in short-term studies.
Pooled analyses of placebo-controlled antidepressant trials were conducted.
The trials covered about 77,000 adults and more than 4,500 children and teenagers.
The risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in people aged 24 and under was higher with an antidepressant than with placebo.
The risk varied considerably between different antidepressants.
The risk also varied by condition.
The highest rate was in people being treated for depression.
The difference between antidepressant and placebo, per 1,000 patients treated, was:
Age (years) | Difference compared with placebo
Under 18 | 14 more patients with suicidal thoughts or behaviors
18 to 24 | 5 more patients
25 to 64 | 1 fewer patient
65 and over | 6 fewer patients
It is not known whether this risk continues beyond about four months of treatment.
There is good evidence that antidepressants delay depression coming back in adults.
Triplet: ["Risk", "varied by", "condition"]

The relation 'varied by' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject risk or effect showed differences depending on the factor specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'cost varies based on': The subject drug's cost is influenced by the factor specified by the object entity.
B. 'has dose adjustment instruction': The subject drug may require changes in dosage based on the condition or factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'depend on': The subject entity is determined or varies based on the specific entity specified by the object entity.
D. 'may be less effective in': The subject drug may not work as well in patients with the condition or factor specified by the object entity.
E. 'causes': The subject drug leads to or results in the effect or condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
